content.scenario: The State Government of Tamil Nadu recognizes a laboratory for testing consumer goods, as per the guidelines issued by the Central Government. The laboratory is authorized to conduct tests to determine whether consumer goods suffer from any defects.
content.outcome: The State Government has the power to recognize laboratories for testing consumer goods, as per the provisions of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.
